content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant upward bias during periods of high sentiment, failing to capture subsequent price drops.", "Forecasts display excessive lag, remaining flat while true prices experience sharp volatility and mean reversion.", "Sentiment scores above 0.67 correlate with model overshooting, as forecasts ignore bearish reversals.", "The model fails to anticipate sudden price spikes, consistently underestimating true outcomes during bullish sentiment shifts.", "Forecasts assume linear stability, missing the cyclical nature of EU ETS prices driven by sentiment changes.", "High sentiment history combined with flat forecasts indicates a structural inability to price in momentum.", "Correction requires adjusting forecasts downward when sentiment is high but recent history shows declining prices.", "Apply mean-reversion adjustments to forecasts when sentiment diverges from the immediate price trend."]}
